brief.text: AMM pool invariant - the product (A * B) after swap in/out has to remain at least the same: (A + in) * (B - out) >= A * B XRP round-off may result in a smaller product after swap in/out.

content.text: To address this:

items.text: if on swapIn the out is XRP then the amount is round-off downward, making the product slightly larger since out value is reduced.

if on swapOut the in is XRP then the amount is round-off upward, making the product slightly larger since in value is increased. Swap assetIn into the pool and swap out a proportional amount of the other asset. Implements AMM Swap in.

finishMultiSigningData caps the passed in serializer with each signer's unique data.

brief.text: Save a validated ledger to the relational database, once.

content.text: The pending-saves entry for the sequence is finished on every exit, so a save that throws leaves no sequence marked in progress: a later save of the same ledger can run, and a synchronous caller waiting on it wakes up. The SAVED flag
pendSaveValidated()

set on the ledger hash is cleared as well, so that later save is not deduplicated away. The sequence is also removed from the complete range, since the write may have deleted the ledger's row before it failed.

returns.text: Whether the database reported the save as done.
